changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: The Instructor Feedback Settings page (issue #429): one row per saved version, never updated, the id being the version number. notes_text is the Markdown of the 'Notes on TA/ULA tradeoffs' under the instructors' allocation feedback form, with ${field}s filled in for the quarter. created_at is Pacific wall-clock time set by the server; editor_email is the admin who saved it. Version 1 is inserted here: the text the notes showed before this change, written with the new fields, so instructors see no change on deploy; it has no editor. Later settings of the same page (issue #430) are added as columns. Roll back with liquibase rollback-count 1: the table is dropped.

column.name: notes_text
column.value:
Note that the current estimated cost of a TA is ${estimatedCostPerTA} while the estimated cost of a ULA is ${estimatedCostPerULA}. This means that on a cost basis, the ratio of TA to ULA is ${taToUlaCostRatio}.

On the other hand, TAs work 20 hours per week, while ULAs work 10 hours per week.

We are not always in a position to trade off TAs for ULAs in precisely the way each faculty member would prefer; there are constraints other than faculty preferences that we must satisfy. That being said, we will do our best to take your preferences into consideration.
